name: M-LSD line segments
plain: M-LSD (NAVER, AAAI 2022): finds the straight line segments of a photo (rooms, buildings) with a small MobileNetV2 network and draws them as a 1-pixel line map for the MLSD ControlNet; returns the segments too. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
summary: Mobile line segment detector (Gu et al., AAAI 2022; controlnet_aux `MLSDdetector`, ComfyUI's "M-LSD Lines"): a MobileNetV2 network that predicts segment centers and end-point displacements; returns the straight segments and the 1-pixel line map ControlNet's MLSD model takes.

papers.title: Towards Light-weight and Real-time Line Segment Detection

no_kernels_reason: a MobileNetV2 CNN (cuDNN); decoding is a few small ops; no custom kernel measured to pay off
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a line / edge map `[H, W]` in [0, 1] at the input size (1 = line), the ControlNet preprocessors (line art, HED, PiDiNet, TEED / Anyline); M-LSD also returns straight line segments.

variants.name: mlsd

licence.training_note: Not stated for this checkpoint; the M-LSD paper trains on the Wireframe dataset (Huang et al. 2018, no licence stated).

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
